text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — multiple model fetch failures from Hugging Face artifact hosting observed across hosted + private deploys. Error rate spike detected for /artifacts GETs since 08:12 UTC. Please acknowledge.

Jordan (oncall-ml): Ack. I'm looking. Do we have a quick scope? Which models/regions affected?

Priya (sre): We're seeing 429s + occasional 503s when fetching model shards. Spike started ~08:12 UTC. Affects both EU and us-west artifact pulls, but EU seems worse. Cold starts for previously-warm workers are failing to fetch, so customer requests are getting 5xx.

Ethan (backend): Confirmed logs show HF returning 429 with Retry-After sometimes, other times just 503. Example from model-fetcher: 

```
2026-06-14T08:13:02Z model-fetcher ERROR fetchArtifact("redwood/gptq-13b") status=429 body="rate limit"
2026-06-14T08:13:03Z model-fetcher INFO retrying after 12s
2026-06-14T08:13:10Z model-fetcher ERROR fetchArtifact("redwood/gptq-13b/shard-2") status=503
```

Jordan (oncall-ml): Good logs. Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) Enable local artifact proxying from our S3 cache for popular models 2) Increase retry/backoff cap and honor Retry-After headers 3) Failover to smaller quantized variant we already cache (gptq-7b) for non-critical routes.

Maya (infra): We have an internal artifact-cache S3 for recent downloads but not all clusters are wired to it. I can flip a feature-flag to prefer artifact-cache in EU and us-west within 5m. That should avoid HF for cached models.

Lena (support): Which customers are impacted? I need a short comms blurb. Any enterprise customers on Dedicated/Private affected?

Priya (sre): Impact: Hosted API traffic for generation endpoints: error rate up 2.3% -> 18% for token generation in EU region. Dedicated customers with cold-starts who haven't pre-pulled models are seeing cold starts fail and return 502. Private deployments self-hosting HF artifacts aren't affected unless they rely on our default upstream.

Jordan (oncall-ml): Action list: Jordan -> coordinate HF support + open ticket; Maya -> enable artifact-cache fallback for EU & us-west (ETA 5m); Ethan -> bump retry policy to max 6 retries with exponential backoff and respect Retry-After (deploy change); Priya -> update incident doc and tag SRE rotation; Lena -> prepare customer note.

HF-status-bot: Hugging Face Reports: Degraded performance for artifact downloads in eu-central-1 and us-west-2. https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/abcd1234 (updated 08:18 UTC)

Ethan (backend): Quick config I'm going to push to reduce immediate 5xx noise:

```yaml
modelFetcher:
  maxRetries: 6
  baseDelayMs: 200
  maxDelayMs: 30000
  respectRetryAfter: true
  fallbackCandidates:
    - redwood/gptq-13b-int8 (if available)
    - redwood/gptq-7b
```

Jordan (oncall-ml): Please include header capture for requests to HF so we can hand to HF support: `X-Request-ID`, upstream response headers, and timestamps. Ethan, add that to the fetcher logs.

Maya (infra): Feature flag flipped for artifact-cache preference in EU/us-west. Starting rollout to 20% of router traffic now, will ramp to 100% in 3m if stable.

Priya (sre): Noted. I'm updating incident doc with timeline and impact numbers. Also adding mitigation steps and linking HF support ticket once Jordan has it.

Lena (support): Draft for customer comms — short, factual, no blame: 

"We are experiencing increased latency and intermittent errors for model loads due to degraded artifact download availability from a third-party provider (Hugging Face). Our engineers have implemented fallback routing to our cached artifact store and additional retries. You might see reduced cold-start reliability for a short window while mitigation rolls out. We will follow up with an email when fully resolved."

Jordan (oncall-ml): I'm opening HF ticket and will drop logs. HF asked for sample request/response headers and request IDs. Creating ticket now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty -> Escalation to SRE rotation at 08:21 UTC (page sent to Priya, Jordan).

Ethan (backend): Deployed retry/backoff change (canary) and header capture. Early canary shows artifact-cache hits are serving models successfully for most popular variants. 5xx rate dropping to 6% in canary region.

Maya (infra): Rolling the artifact-cache preference to 100% in EU/us-west now. Watch for any cache-thrashing.

Priya (sre): Updating status: mitigation in progress. Estimated customer-impact window: 08:12 - 08:40 UTC (ongoing). Assigning severity: sev2 until full recovery.

Jordan (oncall-ml): HF support responded: they're seeing throttling from our account pattern due to a surge across many customers. They suggested backoff and using authenticated enterprise CDN for high-throughput artifact hosting. They opened a backend ticket and will notify if they lift rate limits.

Lena (support): Sending initial comms to affected customers now. Will include the mitigation steps and ETA.

Ethan (backend): Note for postmortem: consider pre-warming common model variants into our internal cache on deployment rollout and add policy to prefetch on Dedicated contract activation. Also record which models caused the highest error volume.

Jordan (oncall-ml): Handoff: I'm going offline for another meeting at 08:40. Priya, can you take incident lead and complete the HF ticket follow-up + closure?

Priya (sre): Got it — taking lead. Jordan, add any outstanding artifacts to the doc. I'll confirm when we can move to monitoring-only.

incident-bot: Incident state updated -> Mitigating (08:32 UTC).

HF-status-bot: HF status update: rate limiting partially alleviated in us-west; eu-central still degraded (08:36 UTC).

Priya (sre): Update 08:45 UTC: 5xx down to baseline (~0.8%) in us-west and 2.1% in EU. Artifact-cache fallback + retries handled most load. Keeping sev2 until HF confirms full recovery.

Lena (support): Sent customer notes, included temporary mitigations and link to status page. Added backlog item for CS to follow up with high-value customers.

Ethan (backend): Post-incident action items I've logged: prefetch policy, limit parallel downloads per model, add circuit-breaker for HF 429 patterns, and an internal artifact proxy with CDN option.

Priya (sre): Handoff complete to oncall rotation. Will finalize postmortem draft once HF provides final incident timeline. Closing real-time channel; will update incident doc and ping for review. :white_check_mark:

Jordan (oncall-ml): Thanks team. Good mitigation work.

Maya (infra): Adding instrumentation to track artifact-cache hit rates over the next 48h.

incident-bot: Thread archived (08:50 UTC).
